--  Notes:- Removed Lower from natco_code as there is no value in caps
--  Internalemployee filter is always no only in whole dataset so removing additional filters

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
         event_date
        ,guest_id
        ,action
        ,label
        ,page_name
        ,order_id
        
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
        {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
        AND natco_code = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )	
        AND lower(category) = 'tariffchange'        
),
base_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%BASKET%' 
            THEN guest_id 
        END) AS basket_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN lower(action) = 'onecheckoutinitiated'
            THEN guest_id 
        END) AS onecheckout_initiated,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN page_name LIKE '%BASKET%' 
            AND label IN ('Dalej', 'Zur Kasse')
            THEN guest_id 
        END) AS basket_continue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE  
            WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%checkout/personalinfo%' 
            AND action = 'PageView' 
            THEN guest_id 
        END) AS personalinfo_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN lower(page_name) LIKE '%consent%' 
            AND action = 'PageView' 
            THEN guest_id 
        END) AS orderreview_page,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN lower(action) = 'purchasesuccess' 
            THEN guest_id 
        END) AS order_placed
    FROM base
)
SELECT 'Basket'                AS screen, basket_page           AS users FROM base_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OneCheckout Initiated' AS screen, onecheckout_initiated AS users FROM base_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Basket_continue'       AS screen, basket_continue       AS users FROM base_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Personalinfo'          AS screen, personalinfo_page     AS users FROM base_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Orderreview'           AS screen, orderreview_page      AS users FROM base_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Order Placed'          AS screen, order_placed          AS users FROM base_agg
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
